title: Purpose and accountable use boundary
canonical_definition: The intended purpose, accountable owner, permitted uses and excluded uses are explicit and controlled.
governance_purpose: Prevent purpose ambiguity and uncontrolled use expansion.

primary_questions.question: Is the intended purpose explicit and attributable?

atomic_subcriteria.title: Purpose is explicit
atomic_subcriteria.description: Purpose is documented with users, outcomes and limits.

evidence_rules: Repository metadata alone cannot establish accountable ownership.
false_positive_guards: Do not treat a package description as an approved purpose.
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer an owner from commit authors.

BLOCK: Deployment without an accountable owner or bounded purpose.

normative_source_mappings.title: Internal AI Governance Process
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: Defines the organizational purpose and ownership record.

finding_definitions.title: Purpose or accountable owner is not adequately established
